name: 空气呼吸器使用时间计算

map.输入气瓶容积、压力、呼吸频率与劳动强度，估算正压式空气呼吸器的可用使用时间。: Enter the cylinder volume, pressure, breathing rate and work intensity to estimate the usable service time of a positive-pressure SCBA.
map.空气呼吸器可用气量 usable = V·(P−P_alarm)÷P_atm（V: SCBA usable air usable = V·(P−P_alarm)/P_atm (V = cylinder volume in L, P = cylinder pressure in MPa, P_atm=0.101325 MPa); consumption rate = breathing rate × tidal volume; service time t = usable/consumption rate; safe time = 0.75·t.
map.💡 可用空气量 = V×(P−P报警)/0.101325；消耗率 = 呼吸频率: 💡 Usable air = V×(P−P_alarm)/0.101325; consumption rate = breathing rate × tidal volume; service time = usable air / consumption rate.
map.报警压力为残气报警起点，通常 5~6 MPa，听到报警须立即撤离。: The alarm pressure is the residual-air alarm threshold, usually 5-6 MPa; evacuate immediately when the alarm sounds.
map.劳动强度越大、呼吸越急促，耗气越快，重度作业时间约减半。: The greater the work intensity and the faster the breathing, the faster the air is consumed; heavy work roughly halves the time.
map.建议保留 25% 时间余量用于撤离，不可将全部时间用于作业。: Reserve 25% of the time for withdrawal; do not use the entire supply for work.
map.实际耗气受个体差异、面罩密封、心理状态影响，结果仅供估算。: Actual consumption is affected by individual variation, mask seal and psychological state; the result is for estimation only.
map.进入浓烟、缺氧场所前按气瓶储量与耗气率估算可用与安全作业时间。: Before entering dense smoke or oxygen-deficient areas, estimate the usable and safe working time from the cylinder capacity and consumption rate.
map.设定撤离余量，避免呼吸器余气不足导致救援人员伤亡。: Set a withdrawal margin to prevent casualties from insufficient residual air.
map.训练演示不同劳动强度下耗气率对作业时间的显著影响。: In training, demonstrate the significant effect of the consumption rate on working time under different work intensities.
map.6.8 L/30 MPa 气瓶、耗气 30 L/min 的核算: Calculation for a 6.8 L/30 MPa cylinder at 30 L/min consumption
map.按默认参数（气瓶 6.8 L、充气压力 30 MPa、耗气率 30 L/min、: With the default parameters (cylinder 6.8 L, fill pressure 30 MPa, consumption rate 30 L/min, 25% withdrawal margin retained): total stored air about 2013 L, usable air 1644 L, service time about 54.8 min, safe working time about 41.1 min; the tool rates it 'sufficient air'. High-intensity work can double the consumption rate, so a more conservative estimate should prevail in practice.
map.余量用于撤离途中的呼吸与突发滞留，防止回程压力不足；规范通常要求报警后仍有足够气: The margin is for breathing on the way out and unexpected delays, preventing insufficient pressure on the return; codes usually require sufficient air to reach a safe area after the alarm, and 25% is a common conservative value.
map.耗气率如何取？: How is the consumption rate chosen?
map.静坐约 20~30 L/min，搬运/攀降等重体力可达 40~60 L/min；: At rest about 20-30 L/min, while heavy work such as carrying or climbing can reach 40-60 L/min; time estimation should use the upper limit for the task intensity, better short than long.
map.根据正压式空气呼吸器气瓶容积、压力与使用者劳动强度，估算可用使用时间与安全作业时: Based on the cylinder volume and pressure of a positive-pressure SCBA and the user's work intensity, estimate the usable service time and safe working time, providing a safety reference for interior firefighting and rescue operations.
map.考虑报警压力残气扣减: Accounts for residual-air deduction at the alarm pressure
map.输出可用空气量与耗气率: Outputs the usable air volume and consumption rate
map.自动计算安全作业时间: Automatically computes the safe working time
